We found out the game was takign a LOT of memory for how simple the game is due to how unity handles game objects.

We've moved a lot of assets to the new Addressables system so that we can serve them from our CDN instead. Huge performance boost. However, you may notice in this update that some assets have a slight delay when loading a game. That only happens the first load. We'll be addressing that in further updates/fixes

notes.title: Storm Area 51 Update 12.0 "New Attacker Class & Map"
notes.notes:
[h1]Storm Area 51 Game with Attacker Updates[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1142130/They_Cant_Stop_All_Of_Us/]Storm Area 51 Game[/url] Let's you experience a true Area 51 Raid
[b]Not seeing the update?[/b]
Steam doesn't usually inform the player right away of the update, they tend to wait until you restart your Steam client or until a bit later after the update has come out. So if you want to get the update right away you can do the following:
[list]
[*] Right-click the game in your library and select properties
[*] Go to "Local Files" and click "Verify integrity of game files"
[*] The game should immediately start updating!
[/list]

[h1]Update 12.0[/h1]
With all the love the defenders have been receiving (class abilities, outfits) I thought it was about time the attackers got something as well!

[h1]New Map[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/d5747376bc1bc0eb798f6f6e8f58d7d3adf036d7.png[/img]

[u][b]Voyager[/b][/u]
Docked at a pristine space station, the ship Voyager finds itself being boarded by an unwelcome crew! Keep them from getting to the internal section of the ship by stopping them at the ship's hangar. The fate of the ship & her crew lies in your hands.

[h1]New Class to storm area 51 with[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/59dd439aca70b229d1c009c559327849505167dc.png[/img]

[u][b]Space Attacker Class[/b][/u]
A new set of 7 units based around the art of space warfare. As with previous classes this aims to improve further by helping to make the game more intense through new unique unit combinations & play styles. This class is mostly made up of ranged units (albeit some such as the Paladin are close quarters ranged) as is required by space warfare. This adds a new focus for defenders & attackers alike on countering units.

[h1]Conclusion - Storming Area 51 Game[/h1]
This update is coming out a little later than usual. I stayed up late as I usually did to finish it the night before, but this was a simple case of sleeping in late. After I woke up it takes me about an hour to write these announcements & make all the graphics for them (thumbnail, in-announcement images, etc.)

I had intended for this update to have 3 maps, then yesterday even spoke it down to 2, but today realized there just wasn't enough time and went with 1. I'm really happy with how it turned out though, my goal was to push myself & see if I just spent more time on a level instead of pumping out a bunch of them what I could do & I think the result was a more visually stunning level that's just overall more visually enjoyable.

]
Sincerely,
Blake Gillman

[h1]Update 10.0[/h1]
I just got a brand new job and this wraps up the first week of work. With that being said, I've been so busy that I didn't have more than a couple days to work on this update so I decided to work on polishing existing features / adding some minor new ones!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[b]New Addons[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacker Timer 2x Faster - Cuts the income timer time for Attacker in half
[*] Big Heads - All defenders get swollen heads like chibis
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned loading screen UI
[*] Fixed first person addon moving mouse up/down resulting in screen curving left/right
[*] Reduced first person addon screen sway
[*] Addon prompt now shows users what addons a server has before joining
[*] Attacker camera will now move faster when holding left shift
[*] Added grawlix to server/room names
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed grawlix being bypassed by connecting characters
[/list]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
So with the addition of new addons I thought it was no longer reasonable to just say that a server was "using addons" so now the addon prompt includes what addons a server is using.

Another important thing was polishing up the first person addon some more. [h1]Addons[/h1]
Addons are a new system which allows players to choose custom parameters to play the game with. In the future this could mean things as simple as giving defenders unlimited ammo to changing the entire game's perspective.

Addon's as a general rule are likely to be buggy, unbalanced, or have other issues - That's why they're addons and not core game features, so that things can be experimented with and users can have fun with those experiments!

If you're using addons, users will get a warning that your server is modified to be different from the default game, and matchmaking won't connect users to your server. This is to prevent new players from having to deal with experimental features while they're still getting used to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/b2ea0981e20d389f840dc8d4bd9a07a98ff55a1a.png[/img]

The most unbalanced feature of this addon is seeing enemies coming in-advance in certain scenarios, a fog was placed to prevent this but on maps where the sky is exposed more openly this becomes more of an issue. notes.title: Medical complications - No update today
notes.notes:
Yesterday, at about 7:30 PM I called 911. I thought I was having a stroke because about 5 minutes earlier a nerve in my left temple felt like it pulsated and then my mind went blank & I forgot what I was doing, the left side of my face had begun to feel what I can only describe as like a fuzziness/TV static. These last few weeks I've been having really heavy heartbeats that almost make it feel like my heart is sore from beating. This created what I would call a sense of paranoia regarding my health, and I knew that I was paranoid, so when I had that fuzziness/TV static feeling I ignored it as my mind playing tricks on me, a nocebo if you will. But then suddenly the left side of my face started to go numb, so I picked up the phone and called 911.

The numbness in total lasted about 20 seconds. I called 911 and after about 10 seconds a man answered. I described to him everything that had just happened, as well as my uncertainty since I didn't know whether or not it was my own mind playing tricks on me due to my previous paranoia. He took down my phone number & address, but then I stopped him. I asked him how much an ambulance was and expressed that I didn't know if I could afford one or not because I didn't know if I had health coverage or not. He said he had no idea, and asked if maybe I wanted to call a friend/family to drive me to the hospital, so I said I'd do that.

I called my brother & asked him where he currently was, he was in Canada on a business trip. I told him I needed someone to drive me to the hospital and briefly (in about 4 seconds) explained my symptoms, he said he'd call some nearby family and to wait, so I did.

After about 10 minutes (Or perhaps that's an exaggeration since at this point I was a bit shaken up) he called back saying nobody was there to answer & to call 911. I expressed that I already had but then called him because I didn't know how much an ambulance was or if I could even afford treatment whatsoever (The thought of having large medical debt for the rest of my life was genuinely at that moment nearly as unappealing as the situation because all I could think was how I didn't want to become a slave for the rest of my life to my debt). He told me almost exactly "Dude, just call an ambulance, it's your health" so I said yeah and hung up and re-called 911.

At this point, it felt like I had almost entirely regained feeling in the left side of my face so when a woman answered the call I explained the whole situation, how it initially felt, my current state, and then asked if she thought I was just paranoid and that nothing was wrong. She informed me she couldn't make a medical decision as she wasn't a licensed professional. I asked her if there was any way to ask the EMT's so perhaps I wouldn't have to destroy my savings with an ambulance ride, she said the radio was only for communicating locations & situations. So I decided and said for her to send for an ambulance. She had me on hold for 30seconds ~ 2 minutes (hard to tell in this stressful situation) while she radioed it in, then she told me to wait inside in a comfortable position, to have the front door lights on, and some other general stuff. I told her I'd wait outside instead, the fresh/cold air was nice.

Before the ambulance, a truck arrived with 2 men. One began asking me questions and the other began setting up his equipment for monitoring my vitals on top of my roommate's car (Which at this point it just occurred to me, "Goddamnit I forgot my roommate existed I could've asked him to drive me to the hospital".

I went over the story with them, I also described that drinking mountain dew on some days made the heart problem worse. They asked if I had had any extreme stress. I described how I just had a game release, have been working 80+ hours/week on it, and was getting ready to start on my next project (Forgetting to add that I also have 2 part-time programming contract jobs for other games).

I don't remember if it was the older man or the younger one who said, he'd seen it before and that it was likely a stress-induced problem (stress/anxiety/panic attack). At this point the ambulance was pulling up, I noticed that it had no emergency lights flashing. This indicated to me that my scenario was one of two things:
1) After hearing that I had regained feeling they determined that I was a non-emergency case and didn't need to rush.
2) The 2 people in the truck hadn't radioed back telling them that it was an emergency so they went under the presumption that it wasn't.

Either way, seeing the ambulance's lights off calmed me considerably. I was asked about drug intake if I had had any marijuana, alcohol, off-the-counter drugs, etc. I answered no, said I may or may not have had melatonin (Sleeping pill) the night before but couldn't remember. I asked one of the ambulance driver's recommendation regarding heading to the hospital, and he said that he recommended that I relax, avoid all stimulants such as stress, caffeine, etc. So I decided to go with that option.

During this time while my vitals were being checked & while I was being questioned I had received phone calls from my dad & grandma. My grandma, I had time to answer before the EMT arrived but my dads was during so I didn't. I called back my brother & dad to inform them that I was fine. My brother's girlfriend had arrived on his behalf to make sure that I was okay. I was informed that my uncle/papa (dad's dad) had gone to meet me at the hospital since they thought I was taking an ambulance but would instead be swinging by the house to make sure I was okay. During all of this my mom had recently had her phone shut off because she couldn't pay the bill so my brother had called her neighbor (who didn't answer) and left a message for her to tell my mom about the situation, who ended up visiting me about an hour after the situation was over when she got the message.

My uncle & papa arrived, we chatted for about ~45 minutes, they told me I needed to eat better then after ensuring them I was okay they took off.

That's a long way of saying, I'm a bit paranoid about being over-stressed right now and don't want to take the mountain dew (caffeine) I usually have every morning/night to keep myself going. So there won't be an update today.

Sincerely,
Blake Gillman

notes.title: Update 2.1 "Game Security"
notes.notes:
[b]Not seeing the update?[/b]
Steam doesn't usually inform the player right away of the update, they tend to wait until you restart your Steam client or until a bit later after the update has come out. So if you want to get the update right away you can do the following:
[list]
[*] Right-click the game in your library and select properties
[*] Go to "Local Files" and click "Verify integrity of game files"
[*] The game should immediately start updating!
[/list]

[h1]Servers[/h1]
Because the game is running on a new backend you won't be able to see servers running on versions previous to 2.1. This means when the update first releases game servers may appear empty.

[h1]Update 2.1[/h1]
This update is entirely dedicated to improving the security of the game. The specifics of the update are a bit complex on the programming side of things, but here's a rundown:

[b]Stopping anti-kick scripts[/b]
Kicking is now more aggressive. This means now that if the game detects that a hacker is attempting to stop the host from kicking them, the server will forcefully close their connection. This is a major improvement to help stop cheaters who the game detects as cheating but who were previously able to block the game from kicking them.

[b]Preventing DLL Injection[/b]
The major improvement with this update is preventing DLL Injection. This form of hack is what the majority of hackers were using to force custom code into the game. This meant changing the backend of how the game was built when uploading updates.

[b]The downsides[/b]
Preventing DLL Injections required changing some fundamentals of the engine which included no longer supporting 32-bit computers. Based off of Steam statistics this is estimated to affect 1% of users.

If you're not sure whether or not your computer is running on 32 or 64-bit on Windows you can check by going to Control Panel > System and Security > System and then check under "System type":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/024282e8e49e5f43226f6370af886763ca7ecc76.jpg[/img]

This update's backend work also should help improve overall game performance.

Sincerely,
Blake Gillman

Two beautifully made maps ready for the battle! These maps can only be hosted exclusively by DLC owners, however, if a DLC owner is hosting one of these maps, non-DLC players can still join them.

Attempting to slow down the enemy advance by building large entrenchments at key locations the defenders have been pinned to a peninsula between two rivers. As the attacker, you must now defeat this trapped animal, and as the defender, you must fight over what little land you have!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/34a5d93bed6d8815dac7f949e280c9bcd01a3027.png[/img]

[u][b]Town Square[/b][/u]
The war increases in intensity as you move from the countryside to downtown. Fight in the town square of a once-thriving urban home. Close-quarters limited combat with only so many routes. Fire bullets back-to-back or send dense armies forward to claim the town as your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/aab5f831ffa5856542a4f4566df85f91ec629e3d.png[/img]

Due to their size, they can also block other units from moving through choke points so be careful with how they're used!

A new set of game security improvements have been made to help improve gameplay.

[b]Text popup protection[/b]
Hackers are no longer able to write custom messages in their text popups, so no more profanity covering your screen! This update also includes client-side limited popups meaning your game prevents them from spamming your screen with too many messages.

[b]Servers won't show any rooms running before this update[/b]

notes.title: Getting ready for release: New Content!
notes.notes:
I've been working fulltime on the game all the way up to release to try and bring new features and content to the game, here are some highlights of content you didn't see in the trailer.

[h1]Brand New Maps[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/106c5ec686548a5e0308d6918c86b24415eb41fc.png[/img]

[u][b]Moon Base 18[/b][/u]
Named after the Apollo 18 mission which established the first outpost on the moon. Troublesome civilians who want to see them moon rocks need to be terminated at all costs! Play as the United States government defending this vital intelligence center, or as civilians whose quest for knowledge is unquenched by the bounds of our atmosphere!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/6b6d3b5ecc27a407267036c98119d9ebd35a0578.png[/img]

[u][b]Tunnels[/b][/u]
The raid enters stage 2! After storming the gate the United States military now flees into the underground tunnels of a key drone facility in charge of defending Area 51. Civilians now rush to destroy their air superiority by any means necessary! Hold your ground and keep those drones in the sky, or be part of the swarm to take them down.

[h1]New Classes[/h1]

[b]Heavy Gunner[/b]
Firepower. We're talking about a fully-loaded M249 machinegun with a 200 round 5.56 belt. It makes you feel powerful, like a proper member of the U.S military.

[b]Sniper[/b]
The sniper doesn't fire often, but they do, it kills. Play as a slow but deadly shooter... and hey, are you wearing a grass ghillie suit in the desert?

[b]Rifleman[/b]
An early version was shown in the trailer, but the rifleman now sports an XM8 fully automatic rifle perfect for concentrated fire!

[b]Support[/b]
Who needs a big gun when your bullets are firing faster than they can move? Equipped with a rapidly firing SMG, having a compact weapon lets you fire fast and reload faster!

[h1]A Shiny New UI[/h1]

[b]Clean Defender UI Update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/aa813c70b5586a82d512935da52b1a1b24d6795d.jpg[/img]
Players are now sporting more useful information to help them defend the base core! With a new reload & cooldown bar, you're better able to keep track of your firing and adjust strategies on the fly!

[b]Smooth Attacker UI Info[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35680751/3693096c1c7863a3798954e3659c7c1f8d720dd1.jpg[/img]
Knowing what's going on is hard when you've got so many things to keep track of! But the new attacker UI makes this easy with a unit info display box whenever you hover over a spawnable unit. Now you can easily make the decisions necessary to overpower your enemies!

[h1]Changes to the rules[/h1]

[b]Defender Win Timer[/b]
Originally the plan was that defenders would try to survive as long as possible against the attacker. This, however, meant that games could potentially go on for hours! A win timer has been introduced, if the defenders hold out for 20 minutes they win the game!

[b]Attacker Income Timer[/b]
The attacker receiving income every second as shown in the trailer was overkill! The income of the attacker ended up becoming so exponential that the only way the game could last longer than 10 minutes was if the attacker purposefully didn't use their money. Income is still added every time a unit is spawned, but now you only receive that income every 30 seconds!

[b]Attacker Unit Cap[/b]
Unfortunately, as you may have noticed the trailer was a little laggy for the seconds that over 200 units were on the map. Besides being intensive on the computer, it was also intensive on the server as sending that much information constantly was making the units teleport or walk in-place. So the attacker is now capped at 50 units being on the map at once. This also helps to balance as the attacker becomes required to use more and more powerful units as opposed to spamming low-tier ones.

[h1]Join the community! (And the Discord)[/h1]

It has been absolutely insane getting all this done in the short time since the trailer released! I've been doing all-nighter's, drinking Redbull, and it's really started to take a toll on me physically and mentally. But I do it because I love it, and I love to see people having fun playing something I worked so hard on.
